latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of text-to-video-llm skill.

- Generate AI-powered videos from text prompts using TXT, DOCX, PDF, or plain text files (up to 500MB).
- Automated setup and authentication, with 100 free credits for new users.
- Supports export of 1080p MP4 videos after 1–3 minutes of cloud GPU processing.
- Seamless user interactions covering upload, status, credits, and export actions.
- Cloud render pipeline handles compositing, compression, and media output with clear error handling and feedback.
